about: Recorded answers for FastFlowLM packs this engine does not serve, read by tools/census_watch.py (engine#2171). CI keeps no watcher state, so without this file every scheduled run re-alerted on families docs/npu.md had already answered. A pack whose declared architecture (or, for a repo with no config, whose id) is listed here prints `. NPU FLM` / `. FLM` with the issue that tracks it and does not alert. Hand-written: add an entry only with a row for it in docs/npu.md, and remove it when the family is served (tests/census_watch_test.py fails on an answer for a family the registry serves on the NPU route) or when the issue that tracks it closes without serving it (no test can see that: check the `issue` numbers here whenever one of them closes).
